items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: No, just with us. We were the only band he played with.

ctx.x: Did he play with other bands too?
No, just with us. We were the only band he played with. And he just passed. Passed too, yeah. Then we got a little Joe Wells. I don't know if you knew him. He was a violin player or heard of him?
No, a drummer. I thought he was the one who played violin before or something.
